shortDescription: Creates a resource of Vpc/Subnet in Huawei Cloud

options.name: access_key
options.description: Specifies the access key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: availability_zone
options.description: Specifies the AZ to which the subnet belongs.

options.name: cidr
options.description: Specifies the subnet CIDR block. The value must be within the VPC CIDR block and be in CIDR format. The subnet mask cannot be greater than 28.

options.name: cloud
options.description: Specifies the endpoint of the cloud. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: dhcp_enable
options.description: Specifies whether DHCP is enabled for the subnet.

options.name: dns_address
options.description: Specifies the DNS server addresses for subnet. The address in the head will be used first.

options.name: filters
options.description: A list of filters to apply when deciding whether existing resources match and should be altered. The item of filters is the name of input options.

options.name: gateway_ip
options.description: Specifies the gateway of the subnet. The value must be an IP address in the subnet.

options.name: identity_endpoint
options.description: Specifies the Identity authentication URL. Required if you are using other cloud supported by Huaweicloud.

options.name: ipv6_enable
options.description: Specifies whether the IPv6 function is enabled for the subnet.

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the subnet name. The value is a string of 1 to 64 characters that can contain letters, digits, underscores C(_), hyphens (-), and periods (.).

options.name: project_id
options.description: Specifies the of ID of the project to login with.

options.name: secret_key
options.description: Specifies the secret key of the HuaweiCloud to use.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud.

options.name: tags
options.description: Specifies the key/value pairs to associate with the subnet.

options.name: vpc_id
options.description: Specifies the ID of the VPC to which the subnet belongs.
